children: Lipoc will present and meet with investors at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on Sept. 16, 2026.
Company management to present live on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at 10am ET in New York City.
Presentation will be available via live webcast with replay archived on Lipoc’s website for 90 days.
Management will hold one-on-one investor meetings through H.C. Wainwright representatives.
Press release reiterates Lipoc’s pipeline and commercial product TLANDO approved for male hypogonadism.
